name: Setsuna Otani
source:
One of [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url]'s early childhood friends, due to their parents being old friends themselves. Her father runs the local shrine, which she helps to maintain. Due to sickness, she has been unable to attend school with the others, leaving her feeling lonely. It's because of this that John often takes the time to meet with her at the shrine.

[In game description]
